exact_statement: For every Boolean F=g(f_1,...,f_k) on disjoint uniform physical blocks and fair singleton restriction x in block j, set delta Z=Z-(Z+ +Z-)/2, m_i=E f_i, beta=(m_j+ -m_j-)/2, d=Inf_x(f_j), t=E(D_j g)^2, b=E D_j g and M=E F. With Eplus_mu(g)=sum_{S nonempty} P_mu(S)log2(product_{i in S}(1-m_i^2)/P_mu(S)), D=I-Var and e(u)=u log2(1/u), delta Eplus(F)=delta Eplus_mu(g)+t delta Eplus(f_j), delta I(F)=td, delta D_mu(g)=beta^2(t-b^2), and delta H(F)=t delta H(f_j)+T where T=delta Eplus_mu(g)+delta e(M^2)-t delta e(m_j^2). Writing F=A+B f_j, AB=0, A^2+B^2=1, L(a,c)=e(a^2)+e(c^2)-e(a^2+c^2), one has B_x(F)=t B_x(f_j)+R, R=sum_Z L(Ahat_Z+m_j Bhat_Z,beta Bhat_Z)-t L(m_j,beta), and T=R+JS_x(F)-t JS_x(f_j). All identities extend after deterministic contraction. T=0 if beta=0 or the outer gate is a signed dictator. The existing inner magnitude-mismatch/KL bound transports by t only with the signed remainder T retained; vanishing inner mismatch does not force T=0. No universal stopping-tree payment is asserted.
